LearnProject:5f158f1bedbc2a0020e51f0d.de: "Welcome to 3D Beginner: Roll-a-Ball Game! In this learning project, you’ll:   Use Unity Editor and its built-in capabilities to set up a simple game environment Write your own custom scripts to create the game functionality Create a basic user interface to improve the game experience Build your game, so other people can play it!  "
LearnCourse:682ccaa6edbc2a00b950ac70.des: "In this course, you’ll build a 2D game in Unity — starting from a completely blank project with no assets provided, you’ll create the entire game from start to finish. In the game, you fly a simple triangle-shaped ship using mouse clicks (or screen taps on mobile). Your goal: stay alive for as long as you can by dodging flying obstacles while your score increases over time.\n\nAlong the way, you’ll learn the fundamentals of working in 2D, from navigating the Scene view to coding simple gameplay interactions. You’ll also explore key Unity systems like a user interface (UI), particle effects, audio, and publishing. By the end, you’ll not only have a complete, playable game, but you’ll also have the skills to start building your own original 2D projects. "
LearnCourse:6851b957edbc2a39422885b5.des:
"Welcome to this revamped version of the beloved John Lemon game. We know how much this project means to many of you, so we made it even better! This time, John Lemon isn’t the only one sneaking through the shadows. Ivan von Vamp, a tiny vampire with a big personality, is also ready to embark on the adventure and escape the haunted mansion full of lurking enemies and chilling surprises.

In this Unity project, you’ll create your own 3D Stealth Game from scratch. Starting with an empty scene, you’ll set up your player character and enemies, add audio, UI, and all the details that will bring this haunted house back to life.

If you’re completely new to Unity or already have some experience, you can follow along with the Haunted House tutorials to learn the basics and dig deeper with bonus features.

Ready to take a peek? Check out the 

demo on Unity Play

, where you’ll guide John on their spooky escape, dodging stone-faced gargoyle monsters and floating ghosts.

By the end, you’ll have your own version of the game, ready to share with your friends (or to haunt them with). "
LearnCourse:66fa6d33edbc2a141af15aae.des: "Take advantage of this completely revamped course to learn how to design and build a 2D Roguelike Game. Throughout this course, you will organize and prioritize your tasks, go over complex programming concepts, and explore the use of pixel art in Unity. By the end of it, you'll have a fully functioning game that you can then build upon to make it your own! "
LearnCourse:691f277138cfaaa01c448657.des: "The world of 2D games is wide and full of opportunities, whether you want to make a pixel platformer, minimalist matching game, or retro RPG. We’ve designed this beginner course to be the start of your 2D journey: we’ll guide you step by step through creating your own 2D adventure game, with a choice of assets and options for customization along the way. "
LearnCourse:67e54d71edbc2a08ac8ac6bf.tit: " Tanks: Make a battle game for web and mobile"
LearnCourse:67e54d71edbc2a08ac8ac6bf.des:
"Tanks is back and better than ever!

Originally created in 2015 for Unity 5, Tanks has been completely revamped with new worlds, additional features, and of course, more tanks!

You’ll start with an empty Unity scene; then, one step at a time, you’ll create a fully polished game, published online with desktop and mobile controls.

If you’re a complete beginner to Unity, you can follow along with the Tanks project step-by-step to learn the basics of the Unity Engine. If you’re more experienced, you can dive deeper into the Unity project, add custom features, and take it to the next level.

To give this new version of Tanks a try, check out 

the demo on Unity Play

. You’ll be able to choose your own tank and battle against AI-controlled tanks, or if you have a friend nearby, try playing together! "
LearnCourse:6939c19d4ddfcae2b10bad21.des:
"In this course, you'll learn to collaborate on Unity projects using GitHub

 

Desktop. You'll set up version control, track changes, manage large assets with Git Large File Storage (LFS), and master essential team workflows like creating branches and resolving merge conflicts. By the end of this course, you'll know how to protect your work and contribute to shared projects. "
LearnCourse:6912644dedbc2a0ef2d161b9.des:
"In this course, you'll learn how to integrate the Discord Social SDK’s powerful social features directly into your Unity games, creating engaging experiences that keep players connected both in-game and on Discord.



What you'll learn

By completing this tutorial, you’ll learn the following:

How to set up and configure the Discord Social SDK in Unity.

How to implement Discord OAuth2 authentication for the Social SDK.

How to build a friends list so players can see who’s playing.

How to implement Rich Presence for players to show what they’re doing.

How to create and join lobbies with the Social SDK.

How to enable a player to invite their friends to lobbies in game.

How to enable a player to send direct messages both in game and in the Discord client.



Before you begin

Before you get started, you’ll need to have the following:

Discord account:

 You'll need a Discord account in order to access the 

Discord Developer Portal

. If you don't have one, create a Discord account at 

Discord.com

.

Unity 2021 or later: 

The Discord Social SDK supports Unity 2021 and later. "
LearnProject:63900d0aedbc2a49f6f92113.de: "Where are users most engaged with your Unity game? How many levels do players complete during their first play session of your game? Is the third boss overpowered, causing players to quit? Are they following along with the onboarding tutorials? To gain insights like these, Unity Analytics shows you how users interact with your game, and enables you to drill down for more detailed information.    "
LearnProject:642aaf9bedbc2a1210097388.de: "Are you a creator in need of a challenge? Creators all over the world participate in game jam events to develop their skills and test their ingenuity by making games. This project will guide you through the basics of game jams, from what you can expect when you join a game jam to developing your game after the jam is complete.     "
LearnCourse:662a5f88edbc2a1893237d5c.des: "Interested in learning more about jobs in real-time 3D? New to Unity, and wondering how to start a serious course of learning? Then you're in the right place.\n\nIn this course, you'll learn how to learn Unity the way professionals do. You'll also find out about some real-time 3D industry practices, roles, and responsibilities. Along the way, you'll hear from real-time 3D creators who have been at the beginning of their journey, just like you are — and have become professionals. "
LearnTutorial:688a8aa3edbc2a0164ebccb8.d: "In this tutorial, you’ll learn how to download the Unity Hub, install Editor versions, and add essential modules to start creating your first project. "
LearnTutorial:688b68d3edbc2a0585fd367e.d: "In this tutorial, you’ll set up your workspace, import assets and packages, and get your Unity project ready for development. "
